campaigns.title: Central Qiyah War
campaigns.desc: On February 28th 2019, the Federal Republic Of Chihebere (CHE) declared war against the Ngozi Democratic Republic (NDR), Republic Of The Ngozi (RTN), Federation Of Bassada (BDA), Southern Republic Of Zanzarbaria (SRZ), Kiheza Peoples Democratic Republic (KPDR), and the Federal Republic Of Kszadzie (KZD). Chihebere has long faced ruin and desperation to save its country against economic fallout and restore its claimed "promised lands" that once stored rare earths after those countries' independence around the 80s to 90s.
